title: Episode 123: Ahmad Shah Abdali Invited into India

blocks.text: The narrative opens a larger imperial crisis by describing confusion in Delhi after Muhammad Shah and the rivalry of grandees who cannot hold the center together. Court disorder, factional ambition, and regional distrust create the conditions in which outside invasion becomes possible rather than surprising.

Into that weakness steps the Afghan power, and the page emphasizes that Najib Khan Ruhela invites Abdali into the struggle as an ally who can tip the balance. Ahmad Shah Abdali is therefore not only an invader from afar but a force summoned through Indian political fracture itself.

By the end of the page, the disorder of the empire has become the prelude to a much wider war. Delhi’s internal rivalry prepares the ground on which Sikh, Mughal, Afghan, and Maratha ambitions will soon collide.
